title: PM-WANI (Prime Minister's Wi-Fi Access Interface):
summary: Schemes — PM-WANI (Prime Minister's Wi-Fi Access Interface):

items: Launched on 9 December 2020, aims to provide affordable and high-speed internet access across
India through public Wi-Fi hotspots. The goal is to set up 1 crore hotspots, especially in rural and
underserved areas. The scheme promotes digital inclusion by enabling easy access to the internet
without the need for licenses for hotspot operators. It encourages local entrepreneurs to set up Public
Data Offices (PDOs), fostering digital empowerment, creating jobs, and supporting India's Digital
